title: Indo-European Cognate Relationships database (IE-CoR)
cite_as: Paul Heggarty, Cormac Anderson and Matthew Scarborough (eds.) 2024. Indo-European Cognate Relationships database (IE-CoR), version 1.1. Leipzig: Max Planck Institute for Evolutionary Anthropology; CLDF dataset v1.2.1, doi:10.5281/zenodo.23183358; described in Anderson et al. 2025, doi:10.1038/s41597-025-05445-3.
kind_of_work: cognate-coded wordlist: the words for 170 meanings in 160 Indo-European varieties, in 4,981 cognate sets with roots, loan events and citations, as a CLDF Wordlist
holder: IE-CoR's editors (Heggarty, Anderson, Scarborough) and the 91 authors who coded and revised its sets
glottolog: The release maps its varieties with Glottolog; wety's catalogs read Glottolog 5.3. Its language table is also the dating workflow's input (data/artifacts/iecor/legacy).

curation.language_map: etc/languages.json (from etc/languages.reviewed.json and the catalog bundle)
curation.root_map: etc/roots.json: root languages and loan sources by name (listed in checks/cl-5/root-languages.csv), from etc/roots.reviewed.json
